theme.scene: A picnic on a grassy lawn under a blue sky, with a red checked blanket, a basket of bread, a striped mug, a sunflower in a pot, and a red-spotted mushroom at the edge of the grass.

objects.name: mushroom
objects.draw: A red mushroom cap with white spots and a cream stem.

objects.name: mug
objects.draw: A blue and white striped mug with a brown handle and a red rim.

objects.name: sunflower
objects.draw: A yellow sunflower with a brown centre, green stem and two green leaves, in an orange pot with a cream band and dark soil.

vistaTries.name: 20261014_vista-night-0.jpg
vistaTries.wrong: The place differs from the first painting: cottages with lit windows appear on the left hills and at the far right edge, but there are no buildings in the morning painting. The lanterns on the blanket are also new objects. These are more than a change of light and sky. The framing, the two Peeplets and the night lighting are otherwise fine.
